_comment: Knowledge graph node schema for ICM magnetic field literature. Fields marked [ADS] are auto-populated. Fields marked [LLM] require extraction pass. Fields marked [COMPUTED] are derived at index time.
node_id: STRING — primary key: prefer ADS bibcode, fallback to arxiv_id

layer_1_bibliographic.title: STRING
layer_1_bibliographic.journal: STRING  e.g. A&A / ApJ / MNRAS / ARA&A
layer_1_bibliographic.pdf_path: STRING  local relative path e.g. papers/2004_Murgia_astro-ph_0406225.pdf

layer_2_chunks._strategy: paragraph-level chunks with section context attached

chunks.section_title: STRING  e.g. 'Introduction' / '3.1 Magnetic field with radial decrease'
chunks.text: STRING  raw paragraph text, equations preserved as LaTeX inline

context_window._comment: Parent section summary — attached to every chunk in that section for context-augmented retrieval
context_window.section_summary: STRING  1-2 sentence summary of the section this chunk belongs to

embedding.vector: ARRAY[FLOAT]  stored externally in FAISS/Qdrant; this field is the index pointer
embedding.index_id: INT  row index in FAISS flat index

sparse_tokens._comment: BM25 index tokens — keep LaTeX tokens, physical symbols, cluster names

layer_3_structured._source: [LLM]  extracted by one-pass prompt per paper

methods.name: STRING  e.g. 'Gaussian Random Field simulation'
inputs: STRING  e.g. 'power spectrum slope n', 'B_0', 'beta-model density']

key_quantities._comment: Specific numerical results — the atoms of scientific claims
key_quantities.object: STRING  which cluster/source this applies to
key_quantities.condition: STRING  under what model/assumption  e.g. 'n=2, Lambda_max=768 kpc'
key_quantities.chunk_id: STRING  which chunk this was extracted from

scientific_claims._comment: Falsifiable statements the paper makes — enable CONTRADICTS edges

physical_domain._comment: Controlled vocabulary for graph edge inference — METHODOLOGICAL and OBSERVATIONAL edges
observables: ENUM  sigma_RM | mean_RM | depolarization | synchrotron_emission | RM_structure_function | power_spectrum | X-ray_surface_brightness
field_models: ENUM  GRF | BxC | MHD_simulation | analytical_single_scale | Biot-Savart

compared_against.on_quantity: STRING  what quantity is being compared

open_questions: STRING  questions the paper raises but does not answer

layer_4_graph._comment: Graph topology features. Edge lists stored here; edge weights computed at build time.

CITES.context_chunk_id: STRING  which chunk contains the citation

CITED_BY: STRING  bibcode — populated when graph is assembled, not per-paper

node_features_for_gnn._comment: Fixed-size feature vector for GNN training. Populated after full graph is built.

structural.in_degree: INT  number of papers citing this

semantic._comment: Paper-level embedding (mean-pool of all chunk embeddings)
semantic.abstract_embedding_id: INT  row index in paper-level FAISS index
semantic.dominant_method_onehot: ARRAY[INT]  one-hot over [GRF, BxC, MHD, analytical, other]
semantic.observable_flags: ARRAY[INT]  one-hot over controlled observable vocabulary

temporal.months_since_oldest_seed: INT  computed at graph build time

meta.extraction_model: STRING  which LLM did Layer 3 extraction
meta.manually_verified: BOOL  did a human check the LLM extraction
